title: Deploy fails with 'Hobby accounts are limited to daily cron jobs' or the daily cron fires up to an hour late
symptoms: Hobby accounts are limited to daily cron jobs. This cron expression would run more than once per day.
A job scheduled for 0 1 * * * runs anywhere between 01:00 and 01:59 UTC
Cron times look shifted because the schedule is read as UTC
cause: On Hobby, Vercel rejects any cron expression that fires more than once a day and only guarantees the hour, not the minute. All schedules run in UTC.
fix: Keep Hobby crons to one run per day and do not depend on the minute, or move to Pro for per minute precision. For frequent jobs on Hobby, trigger the route from an external scheduler.
affected: Vercel Hobby plan cron jobs, as of October 2026
